about: Initial water state sources for gpuwm hydro. A new source is a row in this table, never a new code path. rw_hydro_init reads the row; gpuwm.hydro.initial_state fetches through the row's access block. A row is used only when status is admitted (licence read at the source, free access without an account, reader present).

target.supercooled_liquid_citation: Noah-OWP-Modular (Apache-2.0) phase change, opt_frz=1 (Niu and Yang 2006): SMP = HFUS*(TFRZ-T)/(GRAV*T); SUPERCOOL = SMCMAX*(SMP/PSISAT)**(-1/BEXP)

era5-arco.description: ECMWF ERA5 hourly single levels on 0.25 degrees through Google's public ARCO-ERA5 Zarr store. Same licence as ERA5-Land, no account needed.

soil_moisture_transfer.about: Soil moisture is model-specific, so it moves between models as an index anchored at three points of each model's own soil: 0 at wilting point, 1 at field capacity, 2 at saturation (linear between), computed cell by cell with the source soil class, averaged over the catchment, then read back with the catchment's wltsmc, CFE field capacity (init_soil_reservoir threshold / depth) and smcmax. Anchoring field capacity to field capacity keeps a soil that sits at field capacity in the source at field capacity in CFE, so the spin-up does not drain a transfer artefact. method wetness_index (wilting and saturation only) stays selectable.
soil_moisture_transfer.citation: ECMWF IFS Documentation Cy43r1, Part IV, Table 8.9 (HTESSEL van Genuchten theta_sat, theta_cap and theta_pwp per soil texture); file era5-arco/reference/ifs-cy41r2-part4.pdf page 147

gap_fill.name: era5t-arco-raw-days
gap_fill.about: The next source for records the Zarr store serves as NaN. Breakage it prevents (2.9.4 WOOF readiness, 2026-10-22): the store declared ERA5T through 2026-10-16 but served 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-14 as NaN in every variable, so a spin-up over either day gave up (hydro off) or, carrying, ran 1,992 of 2,160 h. The same bucket's raw ERA5T day files (the ones the Zarr store is built from; equal word for word on complete days, measured 2026-10-22) held both days. One file per UTC day and variable on the global 0.25 degree grid; rw_hydro_init forcing-fill patches the crop's holed records from it. Same provider and licence as this row.

water_input.about: Liquid water reaching the soil surface: rain plus snowmelt (total precipitation minus snowfall plus ERA5's own snowmelt), because CFE has no snow module.

pet.about: ERA5 potential evaporation, ECMWF sign convention (downward positive), so PET = -pev, clamped at zero.

era5-land-cds.reason: Licence passes (CC-BY-4.0) but every download needs a Copernicus CDS account (retrieve API returns 401 without a token). Account-gated sources wait for a decision (NOTE-hydro.md HYDRO-WORLD hydro-world-licences 2026-10-18T08:54Z). The WOOF user-credential door gpuwm/cds_credentials.py is the candidate access path.
era5-land-cds.description: ECMWF ERA5-Land hourly on 0.1 degrees, the preferred land state source once admitted.

licence.quote: CDS catalogue record reanalysis-era5-land: CC-BY-4.0 (hydro-world-licences receipt, licences/era5-land/licence.json)
licence.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (ERA5-Land, Munoz-Sabater et al. 2021).

water_input.about: ERA5-Land hourly accumulations run from 00 UTC through the day; rw_hydro_init de-accumulates them.

gldas-noah025-3h-2.1.reason: Licence passes (NASA data, CC0 under the ESDIS data use guidance) but downloads need an Earthdata Login (GES DISC returns 401). Waits for a decision on account-gated sources.
gldas-noah025-3h-2.1.description: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah 0.25 degree 3-hourly. Its soil layers already match the Noah layers.

licence.attribution: GLDAS-2.1 data courtesy NASA GES DISC (Rodell et al. 2004; Beaudoing and Rodell 2020).

soil_moisture_transfer.about: GLDAS Noah uses the same Noah soil physics family; values move as volumetric water clamped to the catchment's 0..smcmax.

pet.about: latent heat flux to water depth rate: 1/(2.5e6 J kg-1 * 1000 kg m-3) = 4.0e-10 m s-1 per W m-2

nwm-retrospective-v3.reason: Licence passes and access is public (AWS Open Data, no account), but the data sit on the NWM 1 km Lambert conformal grid in Zarr, and rw_zarr reads only regular latitude-longitude stores today. rw_hydro_init already computes weights on projected grids (grid.kind projected); the missing piece is a projected-grid Zarr extract in rw_zarr. CONUS only, 1979-02-01 to 2023-01-31.
nwm-retrospective-v3.description: NOAA National Water Model v3.0 retrospective land state (LDASOUT), groundwater bucket (GWOUT) and channel flow (CHRTOUT). CHRTOUT feature_id equals NHDPlus COMID, which is id namespace 0 in the fabric contract, so channel initial flow maps one to one onto wb-<COMID>.

licence.quote: AWS Open Data registry nwm-archive.yaml: "License: Open Data. There are no restrictions on the use of this data."
licence.attribution: NOAA National Water Model v3.0 retrospective, NOAA Open Data Dissemination.

nwm-analysis-assim-conus.description: NOAA National Water Model v3 operational analysis (analysis_assim, tm00), land output on the NWM 1 km CONUS Lambert grid, hourly and current, from the public noaa-nwm-pds bucket (AWS Open Data, four-week rollover). The live initial water state for CONUS forecasts past the reanalysis's last hour: its soil water replaces the spun-up CFE soil at the forecast start where it covers a catchment; groundwater and channels keep the ERA5 spin-up.

nwm-analysis-assim-conus.soil_moisture_note: Volumetric transfer: NWM's Noah-MP layers are the target Noah layers (0.1/0.3/0.6/1.0 m), and the land output carries no soil class, so each catchment takes the volumetric water clamped to its own smcmax.
